activity.notes: In 1927 Abdulaziz was recognized as King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and its Dependencies. The Hejaz and Nejd remained administratively distinct parts of his dual monarchy until the 1932 proclamation of the unified Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. ATLAS records this 1927-1932 composite monarchy separately from both the preceding Nejd sultanate and the existing Saudi Arabia kingship.

sources.title: Treaty between His Majesty and His Majesty the King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and its Dependencies, 20 May 1927 — UK Treaty Series
sources.citation_text: The 1927 Treaty of Jeddah formally styles Abdulaziz as King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and its Dependencies.

sources.title: Unification of Saudi Arabia — Saudipedia
sources.citation_text: Saudipedia states that Abdulaziz became King of Hejaz and Najd and its Dependencies in 1927 and that the country was unified and named the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.
